title: One-Sided Verification Under Limited Expert Review
abstract: arXiv:2610.18089v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI has become increasingly helpful in scientific discovery, yet human expert review remains essential for those problems without reliable automated evaluation, posing a fundamental challenge as candidate generation scales beyond available review capacity. This paper studies verification under limited human effort, where rare valid solutions need to be prioritized while invalid candidates should be filtered out to reduce human workload. We adopt the one-sided verification objective that maximizes the rejection rate of invalid solutions (TNR) under a constraint on the false-rejection rate of valid ones (FNR), making human review cost an explicit term to minimize. Drawing on the intuition that verifying a specific error can be easier than discovering one, we introduce OSVerify, an algorithmic framework that decouples error proposal from error validation. translated_title: 有限专家审查下的单侧验证
translated_abstract: 人工智能在科学发现中的辅助作用日益增强，但对于缺乏可靠自动化评估的问题，人类专家审查仍然不可或缺——当候选方案的生成规模超出可用的审查能力时，这构成了一个根本性挑战。本文研究在有限人力下的验证问题：需要对罕见的有效解进行优先处理，同时过滤掉无效候选以减少人工工作量。我们采用单侧验证目标，即在有效解的错误拒绝率（FNR）受约束的条件下，最大化无效解的拒绝率（TNR），从而将人工审查成本作为一个显式的最小化项。基于“验证一个具体错误比发现错误更容易”的直觉，我们提出了OSVerify——一个将错误提议与错误验证解耦的算法框架。错误提议器通过……在不同粒度上搜索解中的错误（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出OSVerify框架，通过将错误提议与错误验证解耦，在有限专家审查预算下实现单侧验证目标——最大化无效解的拒绝率的同时严格控制有效解的错误拒绝率，从而显著降低人工审查成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OSVerify, a framework that decouples error proposal from error validation to achieve one-sided verification under limited expert review—maximizing the rejection of invalid solutions while strictly constraining false rejections of valid ones, thereby significantly reducing human review cost.
